title: The Debt of Champions
hook: The Great Hall doors slam shut behind them—silence crashes down like a ward.

shots.action: Harry leans against cold stone, adjusting dress robes. Draconia storms down the last steps, heels clicking, yanking off one elbow glove with her teeth.

lines.speaker: Draconia
lines.text: Don't pretend you didn't see me hex Crabbe's drink.
lines.emotion: breathless adrenaline, daring him to flinch

lines.speaker: Harry
lines.text: I saw. I also saw you miss Goyle by three inches.

shots.camera: Steadicam walking backwards in front of them
shots.action: They walk fast, not side-by-side—Harry half a step ahead, Draconia crowding his shoulder. Torchlight catches silver thread in her robes.

lines.speaker: Harry
lines.text: Always. You favor your left wrist on the backswing.

shots.camera: Tight two-shot, 35mm, rack focus between faces
shots.action: Harry stops. Draconia overshoots, spins. A suit of armor's shadow crosses them. Distant waltz music thumps through walls.

lines.speaker: Harry
lines.text: You looked like you were heading somewhere you shouldn't. Alone.

shots.camera: Over Harry's shoulder, close on Draconia
shots.action: Draconia's thumb rubs her Dark Mark sleeve. She catches him watching. Her other hand snaps to her wand.

lines.speaker: Draconia
lines.text: Protective, Potter? Or just curious what the Death Eater's daughter does at midnight?

lines.speaker: Harry
lines.text: Neither. You're the only one who doesn't lie to me. Even when you're lying.

shots.camera: Wide, both in frame, Dutch angle creeping in
shots.action: A beat of charged silence. Draconia exhales, shoulders dropping. She tosses her glove at his feet.

lines.speaker: Draconia
lines.text: Pick it up. You've earned a favor. One. No questions.

lines.speaker: Harry
lines.emotion: steel, but he bends to retrieve it

shots.camera: Extreme close-up: glove in Harry's hand
shots.action: He turns the silk inside-out. A tiny silver key is stitched into the lining. Draconia's reflection in his glasses freezes.

lines.speaker: Draconia
lines.emotion: genuine panic, first crack in armor

shots.camera: Whip pan to long corridor end — Filch's cat eyes glow
shots.action: Mrs. Norris screams. They break apart—Harry left, Draconia right—project-ownerive, synchronized. Footsteps approach heavy and fast.
Harry grabs Draconia's wrist, pulls her onto a moving stair segment. They ride it sideways, faces inches apart, wind in her hair.

shots.camera: Static wide, tower looming above them
shots.action: They land breathless on cold flags. The key burns in Harry's pocket. Draconia smooths her hair, mask slipping back into place.

lines.speaker: Draconia
lines.text: Midnight. Astronomy Tower. Bring the key. Come alone.

lines.speaker: Harry
lines.text: If it's a trap, I'll hex you first.

shots.camera: POV Harry climbing, wand lumos lighting stone
shots.action: Harry ascends alone. 117 steps. His shadow stretches. A door at the top stands ajar, faint blue light spilling.

shots.camera: Slow push through doorway, Harry's silhouette
shots.action: The room is empty. Telescope pointed at nothing. A single parchment on the desk: *I couldn't. — D.* The window is open. Owl wingbeats fade into night.

shots.camera: Extreme close-up: Harry's hand closing on parchment
shots.action: He crumples it. The key sears through his pocket. Behind him, the heavy oak door clicks shut—lock engaging from outside. No wandlight. Just moonlight on stone.

cliffhanger: The key burns hot against his thigh. The door is locked from the OUTSIDE. And someone just whispered 'Accio key' from the shadows behind the telescope.
